user.title: Australian ATIS
user.description: Choose the airports to monitor. Each airport becomes a device with one sensor per ATIS field.

data_description.airports: Some airports (mostly military and regional) only publish an ATIS while the tower is open. Their METAR and TAF sensors still update.
data_description.atfm: Download the Airservices Australia ATFM Daily Plan every 6 hours, for the planned runway mode and arrival rate at YSSY, YMML, YBBN and YPPH. Only used if one of those airports is selected.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Australian ATIS is already configured. Use Configure on the existing entry to change airports.

init.title: Australian ATIS
init.description: Choose the airports to monitor. Devices for airports you remove are deleted.

data_description.atfm: Download the Airservices Australia ATFM Daily Plan every 6 hours, for the planned runway mode and arrival rate at YSSY, YMML, YBBN and YPPH. Only used if one of those airports is selected. Turning it off removes the ATFM sensors.
